Contract LibraryManagementSystemSystem::countDownSuspensionDay() {
          definition:
          obs:Set(User) = User.allInstance()->select(o | o.LoanedBook->exists(l | l.OverDue3Days = true or l.OverDue10Days = true or l.OverDue17Days = true or l.OverDue31Days = true))
            
            precondition:
          obs->notEmpty() and obs->forAll(o:User | o.SuspensionDays > 0)
            
            postcondition:
          obs->forAll(o:User | o.SuspensionDays = o.SuspensionDays - 1 and o.BorrowStatus = (if o.SuspensionDays <= 1 then SUSPEND else o.BorrowStatus endif))
            
        }
